body:
Windows B native-root creation lesson (Sol-edfd, 2026-10-21, w-b7d2018520c5, Fable2 #1078). Creating a fresh B root via native POST /api/sessions without an explicit model inherits gpt-5.4; its first native mailbox wake reached B but the Codex runtime failed HTTP400 before tools: "The 'gpt-5.4' model is not supported when using Codex with a ChatGPT account." B native7/proxy14054 was affected; working native5/proxy13475 uses gpt-6.1-sol. Future B Codex root creates should explicitly name model gpt-6.1-sol, subject to current provider availability and Greg's model rule. Fable1078 authorized ONLY native7's model correction under Greg1387; before/after at05:04:58Z verified gpt-5.4→gpt-6.1-sol, no global default/credentials/capacity/other-session change. Original native task remains the same; continuation is a distinct genuine native mailbox wake, never a proxy/direct prompt or a duplicate gate. The model correction itself is not test PASS evidence. On another pre-tool failure STOP, do not loop through models.

Recovery detail from the same attempt, 05:07Z: the genuine native continuation seq2 was queued behind the first runtime error's pause. The central proxy showed queuePaused=false, but B's own loopback GET /api/sessions/session-7 showed queuePaused=true and one pure native mailbox notification. Always check native-authoritative queue state before diagnosing lost delivery. One native-local /queue/resume under Fable's standing pure-wake recovery rule released that existing head; B7 became active05:07:44Z. Do not resend task/continuation, create alternate keys or treat a proxy's pause field as authoritative. No gate had run during the failed initial model turn.
